notes.title: Countdown To Release
notes.content:
Greetings and Happy Holidays!

We are approaching EA release, and I wanted to give an update on the current state of the game.

Endeavor will feature 37+ playable maps on 1/13. If your playstyle is anything like mine, it should take you 20+ hours to finish every mission/map once. Some of the larger skirmish maps against teams of AI can take 40+ minutes to complete, but the average mission takes 20-40 minutes.

 - 21 Mission Campaign
 - 14 (or more) Skirmish Maps
 - 1 Survival Map (Experimental)
 - 1 Tower Defense Map (Experimental)

All missions and maps can be played against easy, medium or hard AI. The difficulty will vary by mission and map.

There will be 3 playable factions, with nearly 90 unique units and structures between them all. 

I am currently working on a save feature to be included on 1/13. The feature allows for save/load of skirmish games. It will be expanded to all game types after I work out the bugs.

I am very excited for 1/13 and looking forward to sharing Endeavor with all of you.

Nate (Natmos20)
